said: Norges Bank's real responses, recorded by meridian-norges-bank's authors on 2026-11-19 from its open data API (https://data.norges-bank.no/api/), each dataflow's SDMX-CSV from 3 August to 19 November 2026 as received, gzipped: SHORT_RATES (NOWA, its transactions, volume, banks and compounded index), IR (the policy rate, B.KPRA.SD.R), GOVT_GENERIC_RATES (the generic yields), GOVT_ZEROCOUPON (the zero-coupon curve) and EXR (the exchange rates against the krone). Source: Norges Bank; copied with no change to the content (https://www.norges-bank.no/en/disclaimer/). Sample data answers each request from them, and the tests read them.
